_note: Words the daily robot searches on YouTube. One search = 1 of the 100 free searches per day. week = videos published in the last 7 days, day = last 24 hours, new = last 48 hours with NEUTRAL words ("" = no word at all) so the sample is not only the topics we search for. Only videos with a Thai (or Lao) title or a channel from Thailand (or Laos) are kept.
